appearance.identity: Paired concrete vaults, open spandrels, dark basalt portals and rosette handrails.
appearance.exclusions: Exact stone inventory, cast-iron tooling and current temporary repair works.

brief: Compact Kievyan paired-vault bridge with basalt transverse portals, approach access arches, deck and recognizable rosette railings. Original detailed master independently preserved.

sourceFacts.construction: Reinforced concrete with cast-iron handrails; city tourism inventory.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original3082666-triangle/272015896-byte master reproduced exactly; independent31722-triangle medium-fi source simplifies masonry, hardware and panels.

geographic.notes: One inspected river-level picture confirms the paired broad concrete vaults, open spandrel posts and stone-faced portal supports. Standard viewer PMTiles named Kievyan road confirms northeast axis and retained272.304m exposed outline; differing351/364m owner totals include longer approaches and are not used to stretch this source. Western road1029.9605m at native[-150,0] gives approximatebase971.6605m against modelroad58.3m. The opposite road sample differs11m in coarse gorge terrain. Retain the authored level deck and photo-based115m arch; exact vertical curve/bank joins remain uncertain. Narrow live ground opening and a16m preview contact corridor blended to raw by60m remove coarse bridge terrain imprint. This is approximate exterior visualization, not a gorge or foundation survey.

Compact source uses shared basalt/concrete/painted metal; individual masonry joints, cast tooling, cap edges, deck girders and maintenance rails are simplified. Skyline merges the paired vaults; street/closeup restore both vaults and rosette impressions. Physical-device timings remain unmeasured.
